notes:
LTTH Version 1.4.1 Release Notes

LTTH 1.4.1 ships Stream Monsters 1.5.0 as an Open Beta while keeping every other plugin version unchanged, including WebGPU Fireworks 3.1.1.

- NEW: Stream Monsters 1.5.0 turns enabled TikTok gifts into the only source of eggs; free starter and adopt ingress are retired
- NEW: 72 bundled Furry forms cover 24 monster templates across Evolution I, II, and III with verified local assets and a Kenney emergency fallback
- NEW: Persistent interactive PvP lets both viewers choose A, B, or C in timed rounds, with deterministic recovery, replay, XP, stat choices, and privacy-safe public state
- NEW: Separate Collector Score and Arena Rating leaderboards run in configurable seasons while collections, evolution, levels, and stats remain permanent
- NEW: Portrait-first and landscape OBS arenas use one deterministic timeline, WebGPU effects with Canvas2D fallback, five audio channels, and curated CC0 cues
- CHANGED: The six-area Creator Live Center replaces Art Lab; no provider, model installer, generation pool, or image-generation runtime ships in Stream Monsters 1.5.0
- CHANGED: Three active incubators, FIFO overflow, 24-hour ready-egg expiry, configurable hatch presets, Hype milestones, Heart Chains, quests, and editable GCCE aliases complete the gift-to-collection loop
- FIXED: Durable gift deduplication, atomic egg promotion, battle reload recovery, bounded overlay queues, renderer fallback, and structured privacy-safe diagnostics harden live operation
- COMPATIBILITY: The stable streamalchemy plugin ID, existing player data, legacy battle replays, and every published Stream Monsters archive through 1.4.0 are preserved
